description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to Orleans grain storage, including the core IGrainStorage interface for reading, writing, and clearing grain state, an exception class for state inconsistencies, and an optional interface for decoding exceptions.

classes.name: InconsistentStateException
classes.description: Exception thrown when there's an inconsistency detected in grain state ETags during storage operations. It includes properties for stored and current ETags and additional context for debugging.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the state data of a specified grain asynchronously.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes the state data of a specified grain asynchronously.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears or deletes the state data of a specified grain asynchronously.

methods.name: DecodeException
methods.description: Decodes details of an exception, if the storage supports detailed error reporting.
